$comment: Camera preset library. Shared by the editor and the fixture builder. Presets are a convenience only: every intrinsic is copied inline into the plan when a camera is placed, so a plan opened without this file is still fully specified. intrinsicsSource records how much to trust the numbers -- see CONVENTIONS.md section 4.

presets.label: FLIR T650sc — 25° lens
presets.$note: 640x480 microbolometer at 17 um pitch gives the sensor size; the 24.6 mm standard lens gives 24.9° x 18.8°.

presets.label: FLIR A700 — 24° lens
presets.$note: 640x480 uncooled microbolometer at 12 um pitch gives the sensor size (the sheet lists 24/17/12 um as camera dependent and does not say which body takes which). FLIR designates this lens by angle rather than focal length -- 'Included Lenses: 24 deg' -- so the focal length is back-solved from that: 7.68 / (2 tan 12 deg) = 18.07 mm, reproducing 24.0 x 18.1 deg and 0.65 mrad/px. Derived, not printed -- see docs/datasheets/README.md. Other lenses: 6, 14, 42, 80 deg.

presets.label: FLIR A8303sc — 25 mm lens
presets.$note: Cooled InSb, 1280x720 at 14 um pitch, f/4.0, 60 Hz at full window, all printed on the bundled A8300sc sheet. The 25 mm lens gives 39.4 deg x 22.8 deg, derived from the array -- the sheet prints no field of view. The other lenses it lists are 17, 50 and 100 mm -- add them with 'Save as preset' after typing the focal length. Digital zoom is 1x/2x on this camera; set it in the Zoom field rather than by editing the focal length.

presets.label: GoPro HERO — wide, 1080p
presets.$note: Approximates the ~122° wide mode as an ideal pinhole. The real lens is strongly non-rectilinear, so this is adequate for framing checks and NOT adequate for reconstruction — calibrate and populate `distortion` first.

presets.label: iPhone main camera — 26 mm equiv.
presets.$note: Tuned to the ~69° horizontal field of a 26 mm-equivalent main camera. Varies by model; verify before relying on it.
